# b402 Developer Documentation

> b402 is a multichain payment and confidential-DeFi protocol stack. The EVM stack (Base, BNB) ships gasless HTTP-402 agent payments via the Facilitator and Relayer. The Solana stack ships a shielded pool with composable adapters (Jupiter, Kamino) for confidential DeFi. Both share Railgun-style privacy primitives.

## Overview
- [Introduction](https://docs.b402.ai/introduction): What b402 is, chain chooser, capability matrix
- [Protocol Architecture](https://docs.b402.ai/architecture): Shared three-layer model across Solana and EVM
- [Choose Your Chain](https://docs.b402.ai/choose-your-chain): Decision guide — Solana vs EVM by use case

## Shared Concepts
- [Client-Server Model](https://docs.b402.ai/concepts/client-server): Buyer/seller interaction patterns
- [Facilitator](https://docs.b402.ai/concepts/facilitator): Off-chain service for verify/settle
- [Fee Structure](https://docs.b402.ai/concepts/fees): Protocol transaction fees
- [Agent Identity](https://docs.b402.ai/concepts/agent-identity): ERC-8004 (EVM) and Solana PDA-based identity
